title: Iran POUNDS Haifa BREAKING: IRGC Fires Fresh Missiles BARAGE on Israel Minutes After Trump's Speech
text: Iran POUNDS Haifa BREAKING: IRGC Fires Fresh Missiles BARAGE on Israel Minutes After Trump's SpeechA claim-shattered within minutes. Donald Trump declares Iran’s missile program destroyed. But just moments later, the skies over Haifa erupt-missiles, interceptors, and fire lighting up the night. Within 15 minutes of the speech, Israel confirms a fresh missile launch from Iran. Haifa is targeted again, with explosions echoing across the port city as air defenses scramble to respond. Eyewitness footage captures missiles streaking through the sky, Iron Dome interceptors launching rapidly, and mid-air blasts illuminating the skyline. A city under fire-again.
